title: ImUi Color Edit Picker Options Popup v1
problem: Close the Dear ImGui `ColorPickerOptionsPopup()` usability gap for editor `ColorEdit` by adding a per-control, popup-local options surface that can switch between HueBar and HueWheel picker shapes and toggle AlphaBar visibility without introducing global `SetColorEditOptions()` state.

repro.summary: Focused color-edit tests and source-policy anchors lock the popup-local picker options surface, runtime option state, and non-global ownership.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

gates.name: focused color edit tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui editor surface policy
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui editor adapter smoke
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_adapter_smoke --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This picker options popup slice is closed. Future color history, eyedropper behavior, palette customization, and full picker polish stay in separate follow-ons.
